_note: The board (docs/design/v2-board.md), route #/bwrdd. Owner: package 4. Plain words (docs/design/plain-wales.md): reading age 11, no sentence over 18 words, coins not pounds, Why? not threads. Full i18n key is board.<key>. Engine Say keys are the same full keys. Plurals use .one and .other with {n}. Names of projects, events, endings and places live in model/board/*.yaml as {en, cy} text, not here. No figure appears here: numbers come in through slots from the model, with their labels.
title: The board: South East Wales

coins.what_note: A coin is a share of the money the government can newly choose to spend. It is a game rule, not a real amount.
coins.grows: Your coins grow as Work and pay grows across the region.
coins.carry: Up to {n} unspent coins carry over to the next turn.
guide.1: This is South East Wales in 2026. Every figure you start with is real.
guide.2: Click a council. Its six bars show how it is doing, out of 10.
guide.3: Build something there. Watch the lines: the effect travels to linked places.
guide.4: End the turn. Two years pass. Then read what happened, and ask Why?
